LAW AND MOTION, 301, DEFENDANT TORRES PLATERO'S MOTION TO QUASH SERVICE OF SUMMONS OR STAY OR DISMISS IS OFF CALENDAR. DEFENDANT DID NOT PROVIDE COURTESY COPIES AS REQUIRED BY LOCAL RULE 2.6(B). JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR# 8189

DECLARATION POS RE: NOTICEOF PETITION TO RESET HEARING DATE FOR NOTICE OF PETITION TO QUASH FILED BY DEFENDANT PLATERO, TORRES PLATERO

LAW AND MOTION, 301, DEFENDANT ROSARIO TORRES' RE-NOTICE OF PETITION TO RESET HEARING DATE FOR NOTICE OF PETITION TO QUASH SERVICE OF SUMMONS AND COMPLAINT IS OFF CALENDAR. BECAUSE THIS MOTION ONLY SEEKS CLARIFICATION OF WHY DEFENDANT'S PETITION TO QUASH SERVICE OF SUMMONS, WHICH WAS TAKEN OFF CALENDAR FOR FAILURE TO PROVIDE COURTESY COPIES PURSUANT TO LOCAL RULE 2.6(B), WAS TAKEN OFF CALENDAR, AND DOES NOT ADDRESS THE SUBSTANCE OF DEFENDANT'S MOTION ITSELF, THERE IS NOTHING BEFORE THE COURT TO ACT ON. DEFENDANT'S RE-NOTICE OF PETITION IS TAKEN OFF CALENDAR WITHOUT PREJUDICE TO ANY RIGHT DEFENDANT HAS TO NOTICE AND SERVE A MOTION TO QUASH SERVICE OF SUMMONS THAT COMPLIES WITH ALL APPLICABLE RULES. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR# 8189
MINI-MINUTES FOR MAY-15-2008 9:30 AM FOR DEPT 301
DECLARATION OF SERVICE RE: NOTICE OF AFFIDAVIT OF DENIAL OF CORPORATE EXISTENCE EXECUTED BY ROSARIO PLATERO TORRES FILED BY DEFENDANT TORRES, ROSARIO PLATERO
MINI-MINUTES FOR JUL-08-2008 9:30 AM FOR DEPT 301

LAW AND MOTION, 301, DEFENDANT ROSARIO TORRES' NOTICE OF AFFIDAVIT OF DENIAL OF CORPORATE EXISTENCE EXECUTED BY ROSARIO PLATERO TORRES AND PETITION BY AFFIDAVIT TO ABATE THIS MATTER IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE IS DENIED FOR FAILURE TO INCLUDE A MEMORANDUM OF POINTS AND AUTHORITIES UNDER CRC 3.113. THE COURT CONSTRUE THIS ABSENCE AS AN ADMISSION. THE MOTION IS NOT MERITORIOUS. ADDITIONALLY, THE PROPER TIME TO RAISE A PLEA IN ABATEMENT IS IN THE ORIGINAL ANSWER OR BY DEMURRER AT THE TIME OF ANSWER. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO PREPARE A FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN CSR# 8189

MINI-MINUTES FOR AUG-25-2008 9:30 AM FOR DEPT 301

LAW AND MOTION 301, THE MATTER WAS NOT ARGUED. THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT ROSARIO PLATERO TORRES' DEMURRER TO UNLAWFUL DETAINER COMPLAINT (CCP 430.10(B)(E)), IS SUSTAINED WITH 5 DAYS LEAVE TO AMEND. NO OPPOSITION FILED. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO PREPARE A FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: DIANE CHEN CSR # 11312 301/PJB
